summary: The implementation successfully delivers all 9 requested requirements (REQ-4 through REQ-12). The diff shows a comprehensive build including conversation management, message input/display, PDF export (single and multi-conversation), search functionality, date range filtering, dark mode, PIN lock, and removal of placeholder components. All features are implemented across frontend and backend with proper authentication, data persistence, and UI components matching the minimalist design constraints.
